chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Amr al-Shami, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Ramadan and Laylat al-Qadr according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the twelve-month lunar calendar is rooted in the moment of creation, establishing Ramadan as the 'month of Allah' and the spiritual center of the year. The text highlights the triad of Ramadan's sanctity: its identity as Allah's month, the presence of Laylat al-Qadr within it, and the descent of the Quran on its first night, thereby instructing believers to inaugurate the month with Quranic recitation and contemplation.
